NAME:
   starport ui - Open the Starport console in a browser

USAGE:
   starport ui [options]

DESCRIPTION:
   Mints a one-time launch link from this machine's local admin token and opens it. The console signs in with a session cookie, so no gateway API key is pasted into a browser and none is stored there.

OPTIONS:
   --no-open   Print the launch link instead of opening a browser
   --help, -h  show help

NAME:
   starport agent setup - Install the embedded starport skill into a skills root

USAGE:
   starport agent setup [options]

OPTIONS:
   --dir string  Skills root to install into (default: $AGENTS_HOME/skills or ~/.agents/skills)
   --print       Write the skill to standard output instead of installing it
   --help, -h    show help

NAME:
   starport models search - Search routable models by ID, name, and author

USAGE:
   starport models search [options] <query>...

OPTIONS:
   --json      Write machine-readable JSON
   --help, -h  show help

NAME:
   starport models show - Show one model's full catalog projection

USAGE:
   starport models show [options] <model-id>

OPTIONS:
   --json      Write machine-readable JSON
   --help, -h  show help
